goals: Verify the application's client-side MSAL integration and authentication configuration.
Verify the application server successfully serves the main web pages.
activities: Initialize test environment by loading necessary modules (supertest, path, fs, server app).
Disable Jest's automatic mocking for the 'fs' module.
Read the content of 'App/index.html' file.
Set the global document's inner HTML to the content of 'App/index.html'.
Retrieve the 'src' attribute of the element with ID 'load-msal'.
Verify that the 'src' attribute contains the expected CDN link for MSAL.
Load the MSAL configuration object from 'App/authConfig.js'.
Verify that the MSAL configuration object is defined.
Define a regular expression for GUID format.
Test if the 'clientId' in the MSAL configuration matches the GUID regular expression.
Verify that the 'clientId' does not match the GUID format, ensuring no credentials are hardcoded.
Define a regular expression for URI format.
Test if the 'authority' in the MSAL configuration matches the URI regular expression.
Verify that the 'authority' matches the URI format, ensuring it's a valid URI.
Set the Node.js environment variable `NODE_ENV` to 'test'.
Send an HTTP GET request to the root path '/'.
Read the content of 'App/index.html' file from the filesystem.
Verify that the HTTP response status code for the root path is 200.
Verify that the HTTP response body for the root path matches the content of 'App/index.html'.
Send an HTTP GET request to the '/signout' path.
Read the content of 'App/signout.html' file from the filesystem.
Verify that the HTTP response status code for the '/signout' path is 200.
Verify that the HTTP response body for the '/signout' path matches the content of 'App/signout.html'.
